tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog skabs kyi drag bskul dus dgra'i dbang po bzhad pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+ra bhe ra we bh+yaḥ lha mchog 'jam dpal gzhon nu bdud sde bzhi// sde dang ris su rgyas pa gdul ba'i phyir// ye shes khro bo chen po'i skur bzhengs pa// bla ma dus dgra'i dbang pos gnang ba stsol// de yi nga rgyal la brten rnal 'byor pas// snying rje khong nas rgyas pa'i nga ro yi// bstan dgra dam nyams las ngan rgyun gcod phyir// lha srung dgra la 'gyed bskul 'di skad brjod// ho dgongs su gsol lo// lan gsum/ mkha' khyab chos sku spros bral dbyings nas ma 'gags thugs rje'i sprul sku'i 'gro don rgyun mi chad pa/ drin chen rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams par dag pa rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i zhing khams nas sgrib bral ye shes rnam lnga'i rang gzugs dngos grub phan bde'i 'byung gnas/ yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// rnam thar sgo gsum rang bzhin chos 'byung me ri 'bar ba'i klong dkyil/ ma rungs gshin rje sgrol ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i sgyu 'phrul zlos gar ye shes khro bo'i rgyal po dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed chen po gshin rje'i dgra nag po/ gshin rje'i gshed gdong pa drug pa gshin rje'i gshed dmar po la sogs pa gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams dang*/ bka' sdod phyogs bcu'i srung ma 'khor sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// bstan dgra dam nyams gsod pa'i dpa' bo/ mi bzad gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod lcags mkhar sgo med mun khang bcu drug gi gnas nas dge ba spyod pa'i stong grogs pa/

sdig pa spyod pa'i chad pa mkhan/ 'chi bdag las kyi gshin rje/ dam can chos kyi rgyal po yab yum/ ya ba ti la sogs pa'i gshed po bzhi/ ka la ra tri la sogs pa'i ma mo bzhi/ bka' nyan gyi ging chen po bzhi la sogs te sprul pa 'bum sde mi sdug pa'i cha byad can/ 'khor lha srin sde brgyad sa 'og sa steng thams cad khyab pa'i drag rtsal can khyed rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// gzhan yang gshin rje khrag mdog e ka dza ti/ gshin rje me ru rtse/ srin po me ru rtse/ bdud me ru rtse/ gnod sbyin me ru rtse la sogs pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// gzhan yang lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gnyan chen po brgyad/ gnod sbyin chen po brgyad/ zhing skyong chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ gzhan yang sa phyogs 'di dag na gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// dam tshig ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pa bdag gis khyed rnams gzu dang dpang por bkod cing phrin las su bcol ba ni/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ mi mjed zhing gi ston mchog dam pa/ sgron mes bskal pa'i rnam 'dren bzhi pa/ gsang gsum yon tan bsam mi khyab bdag bstan pa dam pas 'jig rten snang ba'i byed po/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che'i bshad sgrub yun ring du gnas pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dang*/ rgyal ba'i dgongs pa gsal ba'i nyi ma/ lung rigs tshad ma smra ba'i seng ge zab rgyas gdams pa kun gyi rgya mtsho/ 'gro kun srid las sgrol ba'i ded dpon chen po dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po yab sras khu dbon brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dang*/

rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i skyes bu dam pa/ thub pa'i dgongs don tshul bzhin smra ba'i rgyal tshab chen po/ lung rtogs bstan la mkhas tshul gsum gyi bya ba byas pa/ mtshan tsam thos pas ngan 'gro 'khor ba'i 'jigs las skyob pa'i thugs rjer brten pa/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa'i lung mchog dri ma med pa'i phrin las dang*/ de 'dzin rgyal tshab kyi skyes bu lung rtogs bstan pa'i snang byed gang dag byon pa rnams kyi sku tshe phrin las 'gro don dang bcas pa la rnam par 'tshe zhing bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs 'byung po mi dang mi ma yin pa gang dag yod pa rnams dang*/ skyabs gsum 'dus pa dbang gi rgyal po/ phyogs bral bstan pa skyong ba'i byed po/ srid zhi'i dge legs 'dren pa'i shing rta/ phrin las kun du khyab pa'i kun phan gzhon nu/ dpal sa skya pa zhes snyan pa'i rnga gsang phyogs su ldir ba can gyi gdung sras dbang gi rgyal po'i phreng ba bskal pa'i bar du rgyun chags su 'byon pa rnams dang*/ da ltar 'tsho zhes su bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku tshe phrin las mnga' thang dpal 'byor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dang*/ rgyal ba'i ring lugs kun gyi 'byung gnas/ ngur smrig 'chang ba bye ba'i bsti gnas/ chos spyod rnam bcus rtsen pa'i do ra/ dam pa'i phrin las kyi rgyun mi nub par skyong ba'i chos grwa chen po/ che ge mo zhes bya bas mtshon pa'i rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i rjes su slob cing bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i chos sde mtha' dag gi phrin las/ mnga' thang*/ dpal 'byor/ grwa rigs/ mi sder bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams dang*/ brtse ldan rgyal ba'i myu gu/ rgyal bstan skyong ba'i rtsa lag dad dang gtong ba'i nor can/

zla bral bstan pa'i sbyin bdag che ge mo zhes bya ba'i gdung sras dri ma med pa shel dkar gyi phreng ba bstar la brgyus pa ltar rim par byon pa rnams kyi sku tshe/ phrin las/ chab srid/ mnga' thang dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs zhes pa'am/ sbyin bdag phal pa yin na de lugs dang mthun par brjod/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa'i rjes su zhugs shing*/ sbyin pa dag pa'i yon gnas dam pa gsang chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ bdag cag sgrub pa po yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa/ bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub mor brtsams pa dang*/ brtsam par 'gyur ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren/ byad gtad mkhan gyi rigs su gyur pa gang yin pa de rnams las mkhan rnams kyi myur du gnas gar 'dug kyang rang dbang med par skad cig nyid du khug la 'go ba'i lha dang phyes shig skyob pa'i lha dang phyes shig srung ba'i lha dang phyes shig yi dam gyi lha dang phyes shig le'u'i lha dang phyes shig zhang lha dang phyes shig pho lha dang phyes shig mo lha dang phyes shig lhan cig skyes pa'i lha la sogs pa bsrung skyob kyi lha thams cad dang phyes la bstan dgra dam nyams gsod pa'i dgra bo'i las khang gru gsum pa zin nas thar pa med pa'i nang du khug la bsgral ba'i las gyis shig 'o gzu dang dpang du bzhugs pa khyed rnams bstan pa yongs kyi srung ma/ chos 'khor yongs kyi srog shing*/ rnal 'byor yongs kyi dgra lha/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing*/ bdud rigs dam nyams rnams kyi gnyan po/ bstan dgra dam nyams rnams kyi gshed ma yin pas yid la brnag pa'i dgra bo de rnams la bka'i chad pa drag po myur du chod cig mdangs len rnams kyis mdangs phrogs shig dbugs len rnams kyis dbugs long zhig srog len rnams kyis srog chod cig

shan pa rnams kyis lto ba khos shig las mkhan rnams kyis mgo lus lhu gzugs so sor phyes shig gsol kha ba rnams kyis zhal du stobs shig chos skyong rnams kyis zhal du lhag ma med par bzhes shig zas skom dgra bo'i sha khrag yin pas/ rngams pa'i zhal gdangs shig rno ba'i mche ba gtsigs shig 'khyugs pa'i ljags bskyod cig 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs shig drag po'i rkan sgra rdobs shig dgra bo'i sha la hab hab du zo zhig dgra bo'i khrag la hub hub tu 'thungs shig dgra bo'i rus pa khram khrum du mur zhig dgra bo'i lpags pa lhab lhub tu gyon cig dgra bo'i rgyu ma nar nur du drangs shig gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du lhag ma med par bzhes shig ma shor zhig sku ma g.yel zhig gsung ma g.yel zhig thugs ma g.yel zhig yon tan ma g.yel zhig phrin las ma g.yel zhig bskal pa'i bar du ma btang zhig dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyogs skyong ba bcu/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum/ sprul pa yang sprul bka' nyan lha srin sde brgyad dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis dam nyams pa'i dgra bo'i yul du rgyug la pho brang chos shig ro bro rdungs shig ltas ngan sna tshogs thong zhig nad kyi rkyal pa kha phyes shig mtshon gyi char pa phob cig snying khrag kha nas phyung zhig mgo la thog rgyob cig rigs rgyud rtsad nas chod cig pho rigs rnams la mdze thong zhig mo rigs rnams kyi mngal skoms shig nor la god kha thong zhig zhing la btsa' sad ser gsum thong zhig bang khang sba gzhis sa zhing mi nor bdun rgyud dang bcas pa thams cad zas skal du gtad do zo zhig 'thung skal du gtad do 'thung zhig nor skal du gtad do spyod cig bsgral skal du gtad do sgrol zhig khyed rnams snyan ma sra/ bang ma bul/ mthu ma chung*/ rgyug log ma byed par/ sra ba'i go gyon/ mgyogs pa'i bang thong*/ rno ba'i mtshon char phob la/ dam nyams pa'i dgra bo myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod cig

dmar gyi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du lhag ma med par bzhes la rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs shig ces brjod la/ rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ gtor chen lan gsum gsor te/ lha srung rnams kyis gtor ma'i phud gsol nas/ lhag ma nad dug mtshon cha la sogs pa'i rnam par gyur pa gnod byed dgra bgegs mi nor khyim gzhis bcas pa mdun du gsal bar dmigs pa la brgyab pas thal ba rdul phran bzhin du brlag nas/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsams la/ bsgral bya sgrol byed sgrol ba po ste gsum ka rang bzhin gyis ma grub par shes pa'i lta ba zab mo'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /de ltar byas pas mngon spyod kyi las la 'tshed pa gsum 'byung*/ zhes bya ba'i don to// mngon spyod stobs chen 'bar ba'i gnam lcags thog /bstan dgra dam nyams bang thor brgyab pa'i mod// lus ngag thal bar byas pas gnod pa'i las// bya byed thams cad bde ba'i gnas thob shog /ces 'jigs byed drug cu pa'i gtor bzlog skabs kyi drag bskul dus dgra'i dbang po bzhad pa'i nga ro zhes bya ba 'di ni/ drag bskul gyi tshig rnams grub dbang gong mas byas pa'i tshig don byin rlabs che ba gzhir bzhag gong gi che brjod dang bar skabs bstan pa'i che brjod dgos don bcas pa gsar bskrun 'di ni/ gling mgo zi dgon gyi dbu mdzad bla mas bskul ngor/ tshul rin gyis bris pa'o// // ༄༅// bstan srung rnams la phrin las bskul ba 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal bas rdo rje gur gyi rgyud gsung tshe// nyid kyi sku gsung thugs sprul mthu bo che// gsang rgyud spyi dang bye brag kye rdo rje'i// rgyud gsum bsrung spel byed po gnyer gtad pa// bstan srung yongs kyi sde dpon ye shes kyi// gzigs pa rab gsal mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs// phrin las rnam bzhi skad cig rer grub pa'i// rdo rje gur gyi mgon po dral lcam dang*// zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi sring dang bcas// dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod las mgon che// gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra ming sring gsum// ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul pa yang sprul bcas// khyed cag dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas dngos 'byor gzugs// phra mo rer yang ting 'dzin sngags rgya yi// sgyu 'phrul byed pos gnam sa'i khyon ma lus// dog por bgyid pa'i mchod sprin 'bul ba ni// nyer spyod phreng dang mi dbang rin chen bdun// bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dod yon dbang po'i grangs// lnga gsum dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dang*// byin ldan gtor ma ri bo'i phreng ba bstar// zhi drag rgyan cha rnam mang bgo ba'i rigs// gcod 'bigs mtshon cha'i bye brag ji snyed dang*// mkha' lding bya khyi lcags spyang rta g.yag sogs// gom stabs mkhas pa'i spyan gzigs sna tshogs 'bul// dran par bskul lo rdo rje 'chang ba nas// kho bo'i 'dren mchog bar du byon pa'i bka'// chos dang chos mdzad skyong zhing dar rgyas su// byed par bsgo ba'i 'phrin yig gang bkra ba// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i snang byed sa skya pa'i// bstan pa dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa gang*// bshad sgrub brtson pa'i blo ldan grangs med bcas// sa steng kun khyab rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod// bdag cag slob 'bangs bltos bcas byang chub bar// lam mchog sgrub la sdang zhing tho brtsam pa'i// bdud rigs dam nyams tsher ma'i nags gzings pa// ye shes me lces la gor bsreg par mdzod// mthun don nad med tshe srog ka ring 'dzugs// bsod nams mi dman legs bris khang bzang brling*// phyi nang gtsug lag rig pa'i dbyig gis gtams// lung rigs gdams pa'i sgo brgya dbye bar mdzod// rgyal ba rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob rim byon gyi// sdom gsum yan lag bcas pa'i mdzod bzung nas// mkhas tshul gsum gyi spyod pa rmad byung gis// rgyal ba'i phrin las phyogs bral rgyas byed shog

/bstan 'gror phan 'dogs sgrub la dal ba'i rten// dge ba dbrog pa'i keg dang srir ldang ba// lta byed dbang po nyams pa'i skyon ma lus// myur bas don gnyis sgrub pa'i mthu ldan mdzod// chos srid bde 'byor rgyas pa'i sems can khams// mi dang mi min bgegs dgra'i ri bo yis// byad gtad rtsod pa'i rgyun lugs gang byed pa// mthu stobs lha dbang rdo rjes gzhom mdzod cig /byang chub sgrub pa'i bar chad mi mthun phyogs// khyed cag dran pa'i skad cig rer 'jos pas// dpal mgrin mig gi me yi yid srubs lus// thal bar brlag pa'i grags pa phra mor gyis// sras bcas rgyal ba'i bstan la bdag dad kyang*// yus pa'i bu chung ma la ngud mos bzhin// byang chub lam gyi ci 'dod 'phrin gsal ba// 'grub par mthu chen thob pa'i bden pas skyongs// zhes sgo rum ye shes mgon pos mtshon pa'i bstan srung rnams la phrin las bskul ba 'dod dgu 'dren pa'i shing rta 'di ni/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags yos kyi bgrang gzhir lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarbār+tha sid+dhaṃ bha wa tu// //rdo rje 'chang sogs bla ma'i bka'// dam tshig rdo rje'i gur khyim nas// bstan pa de 'dzin bstan skyong gi /phrin las rgyas mdzad nag po che// gur mgon lcam dral gdong bzhi ldan// gnod sbyin pu tra ming lcam sogs// sprul pa yang sprul sde tshogs bcas// mchod cing gsol 'debs bdag la dgongs// bstan pa'i snang byed sa skya pa'i// chos rjes 'brang bdag gnyen 'khor bcas// bstan srung khyed cag byang chub bar// mgon skyabs dpung gnyen mchog mnga' gsol// phyi nang 'byung 'khrugs nad gdon bgegs// dgra 'dre byad ma'i gnod pa sogs// bar chad thams cad khyed cag la// gsol ba btab 'phral zhi bar mdzod// tshe dang bsod nams sde bzhi'i dpal// lung rtogs yon tan phrin las rnams// cher rgyas bstan dang sems can la// phan 'dogs chos kyi sbyin bdag mdzod// ces pa bse mgon ye shes mgon por/

snyan shal 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol nyung ngu 'di'ang lhun grub phun tshogs kyi ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral du bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
